docs.title: KaamSathi Partner API
docs.intro: Read verified work and earnings data — only for workers who have explicitly consented, only for the purpose they agreed to, and only until they revoke.
docs.rule_consent: No consent, no data. Workers can revoke instantly.
docs.rule_funds: KaamSathi never lends or holds funds and never charges workers. Your product stays on your books.
docs.rule_logged: Every request is logged and visible to the worker.
docs.consent_1: A worker grants consent in the KaamSathi app — usually by applying to one of your offers. The consent names your organisation, the purpose, the data scopes and how long it lasts.
docs.consent_2: The worker can revoke at any time; from that moment your reads return 403. They also see a log of every request you make about them.
docs.footer_note: The earnings summary is verified income data, not a credit score. Lending, insurance and wage-advance decisions, pricing and disclosures remain the partner's regulated responsibility.
